ceu: ✦ The trine between the Sun and Saturn

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Look at yourself in the mirror with the tenderness you show the people you love.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Sleep a little longer, if you can.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Allow yourself a sweet or a treat without guilt.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Tidy a drawer or a corner of the house that bothers you.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Take a different route on your usual way.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.

The trine between the Sun and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Treat yourself to a small comfort that costs almost nothing.
